title: 第九章 我这算是自投罗网了吗？
slug: 次元法典全本免费-次元法典最新章节列表
content_zh:
方正是没想到这些邪教徒居然是从传送阵直接传送到这个地窖里的，毕竟在游戏之中，玩家去沃森的时候看见的已经是被火焰吞噬的小镇，还有到处都是的邪教徒。因此自然会认为这些邪教徒是入侵了沃森。但是现在仔细想想，如果沃森那个牧师的确是邪教徒的话，那么这里的传送阵当然也可以与玛格妲的老巢相连也很正常了。
而邪教徒一方显然也没有想到会在这个秘密地窖遇到方正，从对方的穿着打扮来看像是一个民兵，但是普通的民兵怎么可能进入这里？难道说，他也是自己的同伴？
“你………”
为首的邪教徒望向方正，正要开口说些什么，只见方正已然一个箭步冲了过来，接着他双手紧握着霜之哀伤，用力向前一挥！
先下手为强，后下手遭殃！
这次传送过来的邪教徒足足有十多个人，也不知道是不是他们的先头部队。现在如果方正想要逃跑的话肯定是来不及了，那么干脆抢得先机，先杀他个措手不及再说！
十字军打击！
伴随着方正一剑挥出，他手中的霜之哀伤再次颤动起来，耀眼的圣光骤然爆发，仿佛闪光弹一般照亮了眼前昏暗的地窖，而这也让那些刚刚传送过来，还没有搞清楚状况的邪教徒不由本能的举起手来，挡在了自己的身前。
而这一次，提升了一个熟练度等级的十字军打击，爆发出了方正从来没有想象过的威力。
伴随着方正一剑挥下，剑身四周忽然浮现出了数个十字形的神圣符号，它们仿佛重锤一般向着四周射出，重重的击打在那些邪教徒的身上，接着光辉一闪爆炸开来，而那些邪教徒顿时就被直接炸飞了出去，重重的撞在后面的墙壁上，瘫倒了一地。
这么给力？
看见这一幕，方正也是不由一惊，他可没想到十字军打击升级为范围技能之后居然如此夸张，几乎都赶得上暗黑世界里那些奈非天的技能了………不过仔细想象这两者都是系出同门，一个公司做的，会有这种变化倒也不足为奇。
难道是因为在暗黑世界，所以十字军打击的技能才会变成这样？
不管怎么说，对于方正而言这明显是一个可喜的变化，因此他脑中只是闪过了这一瞬间的念头，接着便迅速消失。紧接着方正再次握紧手中的长剑向后收回，而伴随着方正的动作，四周那些原本爆炸崩裂的十字符号所残留的金色光粒也仿佛被吸引一般附着在霜之哀伤上，接着，方正对准眼前的邪教徒用力刺下。
“啊———！！”
化为光的剑刃瞬间洞穿了为首那个邪教徒的胸口，他还没来得及有所动作就惨叫一声，瘫倒在地没有了动静。而方正也顺势收剑，再次用力向着旁边砍下，又成功的收下了两个人头。但是就在他打算继续再接再厉的时候，忽然一个黑影出现在了他的面前。
“吼———！！”
一只浑身漆黑的，长相诡异的地狱猎犬骤然出现，怒吼着张开嘴巴，冲着方正一口咬了下去。面对地狱猎犬的袭击，方正不得不选择放弃，他一剑逼退了几乎要扑到身边的地狱猎犬，然后再次望向了前方。
此刻其他几个邪教徒也纷纷站起身来，开始举起双手，召唤他们的邪恶仆从。很快，就看见一个个黑洞在他们面前浮现，随后形态各异的邪恶仆从从中走出，挡在了方正的面前。
这些邪教徒看起来还真有两把刷子啊。

看着对方居然能够这么快回过神来，方正也是心中暗叹，同时默默的又把这个世界里邪教徒的威胁等级提升了不少。之前在与活死人的战斗之中，方正就发现真正的暗黑世界中的战斗力和游戏里压根是两码事。
说白了，就是人民币玩家和非酋玩家眼中的游戏体验相差太远！
游戏里软绵绵怎么打都不还手的活死人，在现实里拥有堪比暴君级的力量和防御。而这些本来应该随便欺负的邪教徒，其战斗素质也不亚于一流的战士。
还是说自己玩的是噩梦难度？
事实也证明这些邪教徒的确不是什么软柿子，在利用召唤出来的魔物形成人墙之后，他们就立刻举起手来开始高声咏唱，紧接着一颗颗火球瞬间从他们的手中射出，飞向了方正。
看着这些灼热的鲜红火球，方正也是暗叫一声，接着他急忙就地一滚，躲在了平台的另外一侧。紧接着便听见伴随着“轰轰轰”的爆炸声响，平台开始疯狂的颤动，炙热的气流呼啸着从方正身边飞过，他甚至看见无数的火光四散纷飞，落在地窖周围的桌椅橱柜上，很快，整个地窖就在这些火焰之中开始燃烧起来。一时间，浓烟滚滚，热气铺面而来，放眼望去，只能够看见一片摇晃着的鲜红。

content_en:
Fang Zheng did not expect that these cultists were teleported directly from the teleportation array to this cellar. After all, in the game, when the player went to Watson, he saw a town engulfed in flames, and there were cultists everywhere. Therefore, it is natural to think that these cultists have invaded Watson. But now that I think about it carefully, if the priest Watson is indeed a cultist, then it is normal that the teleportation array here can also be connected to Magda's lair.
The cultists obviously did not expect to meet Fang Zheng in this secret cellar. Judging from the way he was dressed, he looked like a militiaman, but how could ordinary militiamen enter here? Could it be that he is also his companion?
"You..."
The leader of the cultists looked at Fang Zheng and was about to say something when he saw Fang Zheng rushing over with a single stride. Then he held Frostmourne tightly in his hands and waved forward with all his strength!
If you strike first, you will be stronger, if you strike later, you will suffer disaster!
There were more than ten cultists teleported this time, and it was not known whether they were their vanguard. If Fang Zheng wants to escape now, it will definitely be too late, so he might as well seize the opportunity and kill him first to catch him off guard!
Crusaders strike!
As Fang Zheng swung his sword, Frostmourne in his hand trembled again, and the dazzling holy light suddenly erupted, illuminating the dim cellar in front of him like a flash bomb. This also caused the cultists who had just teleported over and had not yet figured out the situation to instinctively raise their hands and block him in front of him.
But this time, the Crusader Strike, which had been upgraded to a proficiency level, exploded with power that Fang Zheng had never imagined.
As Fang Zheng swung his sword, several cross-shaped sacred symbols suddenly appeared around the sword. They shot out like heavy hammers, hitting the cultists hard, and then exploded with a flash of light. The cultists were immediately blown away, hit the wall behind, and collapsed to the ground.
So powerful?
Seeing this scene, Fang Zheng couldn't help but be surprised. He didn't expect that Crusader Strike would be so exaggerated after it was upgraded to a range skill. It was almost as good as the skills of the Nephalem in the Dark World... However, if you think carefully that these two are from the same school and made by the same company, it is not surprising that there would be such a change.
Is it because we are in the dark world that the Crusader Strike skills become like this?
In any case, this was obviously a welcome change for Fang Zheng, so this thought only flashed through his mind for a moment, and then quickly disappeared. Then Fang Zheng once again clenched the long sword in his hand and retracted it. As Fang Zheng moved, the remaining golden light particles from the cross symbols that had exploded and shattered around him seemed to be attracted to Frostmourne. Then, Fang Zheng aimed at the cultist in front of him and stabbed hard.
"Ah——!!"
The sword that turned into light instantly pierced the chest of the leading cultist. Before he could make any move, he screamed and collapsed to the ground without moving. Fang Zheng also retracted his sword and slashed hard to the side again, successfully taking away two more heads. But just when he was about to continue his efforts, a black shadow suddenly appeared in front of him.
“Roar————!!”
A dark, strange-looking hellhound suddenly appeared, roared, opened its mouth, and bit Fang Zheng in one bite. Faced with the Hell Hound's attack, Fang Zheng had no choice but to give up. He pushed back the Hell Hound that was about to pounce on him with one sword, and then looked ahead again.
At this moment, several other cultists also stood up and began to raise their hands to summon their evil servants. Soon, they saw black holes emerging in front of them, and then evil servants of different shapes walked out of them and blocked Fang Zheng.
TheseThe cultists really seem to have two skills.
Seeing that the other party was able to come to his senses so quickly, Fang Zheng sighed inwardly, and at the same time, he silently raised the threat level of cultists in this world. In the previous battle with the living dead, Fang Zheng discovered that the combat power in the real dark world was completely different from that in the game.
To put it bluntly, the game experience in the eyes of RMB players and non-Emirati players is too different!
In the game, the living dead are soft and do not fight back no matter how hard they fight, but in reality they have strength and defense comparable to that of a tyrant. And the fighting qualities of these cultists who were supposed to be bullied casually are no less than those of top-notch warriors.
Or are you saying that you are playing on nightmare difficulty?
Facts have also proved that these cultists are indeed not soft persimmons. After using the summoned monsters to form a human wall, they immediately raised their hands and started chanting loudly, and then fireballs were instantly shot out of their hands and flew towards Fang Zheng.
Looking at these scorching bright red fireballs, Fang Zheng also screamed secretly, and then he hurriedly rolled on the spot and hid on the other side of the platform. Then he heard an explosion accompanied by "boom boom boom", the platform began to tremble crazily, and hot air flow roared past Fang Zheng. He even saw countless firelights flying in all directions and falling on the tables, chairs and cabinets around the cellar. Soon, the entire cellar began to burn in these flames. For a moment, thick smoke billowed and heat rolled over the surface. Looking around, all one could see was a swaying patch of bright red.
